name: Business Formation Residence (Investor/Partner Visa)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires 100% ownership of a mainland LLC (permitted for over 1,000 activities since the 2021 reform, excluding strategic-impact sectors) or a free-zone company (always 100% foreign-ownership-eligible). No universal minimum capital applies for most activities.
requirements.fix_path: Establish or acquire the qualifying company structure.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires documented shareholding in a multi-owner LLC or free-zone company (Memorandum of Association evidencing the stake).

evidence_required.document: Trade licence and company incorporation documents

sources.title: Starting a business - The Official Portal of the UAE Government (Federal Decree-Law No. 26 of 2020 amending the Commercial Companies Law)

notes: MAJOR STRUCTURAL REFORM confirmed and now well-embedded in current practice: the mandatory 51% Emirati-partner requirement was abolished for over 1,000 commercial and industrial mainland activities effective December 2020/June 2021 (strategic-impact sectors — oil & gas, some utilities, transport — remain excluded). Free zones have always permitted 100% foreign ownership, so this reform specifically expanded MAINLAND options to match. No universal minimum capital for most activities, distinct from ae_golden_visa's fixed AED 2,000,000/500,000 thresholds — company ownership at ANY scale can qualify for this route's basic residency rights, though only sufficiently large/capitalised businesses (AED 2M+) unlock the Golden Visa investor category instead. Business ownership plus property is also the profile most commonly cited by tier-3 sources as favourable for the DISCRETIONARY 2021 citizenship exception (see ae_citizenship_naturalisation) — but this is not a guaranteed or fee-based pathway, and this route itself carries no citizenship linkage.
